description: Defines structures and functions for calculating Shared Channel (SCH) segmentation parameters, including CRC size, number of codeblocks, lifting size, and codeblock size, based on transport block size and LDPC base graph, following 3GPP specifications.

classes.name: sch_information
classes.description: Holds parameters for SCH segmentation derived from transport block size and code rate.

methods.name: get_sch_segmentation_info
methods.description: Calculates SCH segmentation parameters based on transport block size and target code rate.

methods.name: compute_tb_crc_size
methods.description: Determines CRC size (16 or 24 bits) for a given transport block size.

methods.name: compute_nof_codeblocks
methods.description: Calculates the number of codeblocks needed for a transport block, given the base graph.

methods.name: compute_lifting_size
methods.description: Computes the lifting size for encoding/decoding based on transport block size, base graph, and segments.

methods.name: compute_codeblock_size
methods.description: Calculates the fixed codeblock size for a given base graph and lifting size.
